senses.gloss: (III)--a son of वेदशिरस्; an अवतार् of the १५थ् द्वापर। वा. २३. १६९.
--a son of अशोक; ruled for eight years. वा. ९९. ३३३.
--a son of वेदशिरस्, an अवतार् of the १५थ् द्वापर। Cf. कुनि। वा. २३. १६९.
(I)--(स्वातिकर्ण) आन्ध्र king ruled for eight years. M. २७३. 8.
(II) (च्)--a kingdom of Madhya देश; a southern country. ^1 Br. II. १६. ४१ and ५९-60; १८. ४४. [page१-391+ २८]

--a people of southern country;
1: M. ११४. ३५; वा. ४५. ११०, १२७; ४७. ४२.
were enlisted by जरासन्ध against the Yadus.
2: भा. X. [५० (V) 3].
(I)--the son of Dharmanetra and father of Sam- jaya (सोहञ्जि-भा। प्।), (Sahajit-वि। प्।). भा. IX. २३. २२. Br. III. ६९. 5; M. ४३. 9; Vi. IV. ११. 8.
(II)--the son of Kratha and father of धृष्टि(a) (वृष्णि-बुर्नोउf). भा. IX. २४. 3; M. ४४. ३८-9; वा. ९५. ३८; Vi. IV. १२. ४०-41.
(III)--a son of कृष्ण and सत्या. भा. X. ६१. १३.

--daughter of शूर and adopted by Kuntibhoja as he was childless. दुर्वासस् taught her a मन्त्र by which she invoked the sun who returned after blessing her with a child. Being an unmarried girl, she abandoned her son in a box, and this was discovered by Adhiratha who [page१-392+ ४६] brought him up. This child was कर्ण;
1: भा. IX. २३. १३-14; २४. ३१-36; Br. III. ७१. १५२-5; M. ४६. 7.
queen of पाण्डु: gave birth to युधिष्ठिर and four other sons by the favour of gods--Dharma, वायु and Indra and the अश्विन्स्; outlived her husband for the sake of their welfare.
2: भा. IX. २२. २७; M. ५०. ४८-50. Br. III. 1. ४०. Vi. V. १२. २४.
Seen by अक्रूर: Narrated to Vidura her troubles after पाण्डु's death. Her affection and love for कृष्ण; addressed him on the difficulties encountered by the पाण्डवस्. कृष्ण comforted her and explained how it was not possible for him to go to हास्तिनापुर earlier.
3: भा. X. ५८. 7. १०; X. ४९. 1-१५; I. 8. 3: 9. १३.
Her स्तोत्र of कृष्ण;
4: Ib. I. 8. १७-43.
grieved at his departure from हास्तिनापुर. Her thoughts on the other world.
5: Ib. I. १०. 9; १३. 3; १५. ३३; X. ८२ 24.
Heard of Drupada's defeat by her sons. Was met by कृतवर्मन् at हास्तिनापुर. At the news of the alleged burning of (पाण्डवस्, etc.), कुन्ती went to the Kurus accompanied by राम and कृष्ण, though the latter was aware of the fact of their living.
6: Ib. X. ५२. [५६ (V) 2], [5], १०; ५७. 1.
Heard the story of the marriage of कृष्ण from his wives and was lost in wonder.
7: Ib. X. ८४. 1.
Left for स्यमन्तपञ्चक, and complained to Vasudeva of his neglect of her sons. Vasudeva consoled her saying that oppression from कम्सा had scattered them in different directions.
8: Ib. X. ८२. १८-22; ८४. ५७ and ६९ [3].
Joy at कृष्ण's visit to हास्तिनापुर. Taking leave of her कृष्ण went to द्वारका.
9: Ib. X. 7 1. ३९; ७७. 7; १०. M. १०३. १२.
(See पृथा) Regret- ted with her sons the loss of Duryodhana and others.^10
--a R. from the पारियत्र hill. M. ११४. २४.

--(Kunti-वा। प्।), went to स्यमन्तपञ्- caka for solar eclipse;
1: भा. X. ८२. २५. Vi. IV. १४. ३२. 3.
adopted पृथा, daughter of शूर, as his daughter. (See Sorenson's इन्देx तो प्रोपेर् नमेस् इन् महाभारत, p. ४३६). पाण्डु married कुन्ती, daughter of Kuntibhoja.
2: Br. III. ७१. १५१-2; M. ४६. 7; वा. ९६. १५०.
--a commander of भण्ड, attacked by महामाया. Br. IV. २१. ८४; २८. ३९.

--a Yadu tribe who took part in the marriage festivities of कृष्ण and रुक्मिनी.
1: भा. X. ५४. ५८.
They went to Syamanta- पञ्चक for solar eclipse.
2: Ib. X. ८२. १३.
Heard of कृष्ण going to मिथिला and met him with presents.
3: Ib. ८६. २०.
Fought with their kinsmen and ended their lives.
4: Ib. XI. ३०. १८.
[page१-393+ ३८]
